Synopsis:
Dialog when interactin with the shrine dedicated to Helm in Stormshore Tabernacle. All players will be able to read some lore about the god. Additionally, if the player is a cleric of Helm, they'll be able to give offerings and pray/communicate with the god to get a blessing.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_StormshoreTabernacle_HelmShrine.json: You are standing at the Helm shrine inside the Stormshore Tabernacle; every visitor can read an inscription describing Helm as a vigilant guardian and the nature of his worship. A Religion check or similar knowledge skill may gate additional lore — failing it yields only the basic inscription text. If the player is a cleric of Helm (i.e., a faithful follower), extra interaction options appear to offer donations and pray, and those actions can elicit a blessing or a narrator cue that Helm’s gaze welcomes the faithful. The shrine’s behavior and options mirror the general pattern used for other deity altars in the tabernacle (for example, the Selune shrine).
- LOW_StormshoreTabernacle_TyrShrine.json: Dialog when interactin with the shrine dedicated to Tyrin Stormshore Tabernacle. All players will be able to read some lore about the god. Additionally, if the player is a cleric of Tyr they'll be able to give offerings and pray/communicate with the god to get a blessing.
- LOW_StormshoreTabernacle_SeluneShrine.json: You are standing before an altar to Selûne in the Stormshore Tabernacle; an inscription on the altar can be read by anyone and gives a short prayer about Selûne’s changing light and guidance. All characters will see the basic lore line identifying Selûne as the moon-and-stars goddess who helps wanderers. Characters with relevant scholarship in Religion (or who pass the associated check) will gain a bit more contextual knowledge; without that skill they get only the limited inscription text. If the player is a cleric/follower of Selûne, the goddess may acknowledge them (the “Moonmaiden welcomes you”), and they can offer gifts, pray, and receive a blessing.
- LOW_StormshoreTabernacle_MystraShrine.json: Dialog when interactin with the shrine dedicated to Mystra in Stormshore Tabernacle. All players will be able to read some lore about the god. Additionally, if the player is a cleric of Mystra they'll be able to give offerings and pray/communicate with the god to get a blessing.
- LOW_StormshoreTabernacle_TempleGuardian.json: Dialog between players and the temple guardian, a halfling vicar in Stormshore Tabernacle. If the player is a cleric of a particular god, the statue will tell the player that they are about to be judged by their deity. This dialog should give some hints to the fact that things could go badly if they acted differently from what the god defends, but should proceed to the judgement anyways.

context: You are standing at the Helm shrine inside the Stormshore Tabernacle; anyone can read the altar’s inscription identifying Helm as a vigilant guardian who preserves order. A Religion (or similar) check can reveal additional lore about Helm — failing that check yields only the basic inscription text. If the player is a cleric/follower of Helm, extra interaction options appear to offer donations and to pray; those actions can trigger a narrator cue that Helm’s gaze welcomes the faithful and may grant a blessing that enhances vigilance or resilience. The shrine’s dialogue and available responses follow the same pattern used for the other deity altars in the tabernacle.
